title: #148 Common Exams
prompt: Exams are commonly used in most schools and universities. Some people think exams should be replaced by other forms of assessment. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: Exams are commonly used in most schools and universities.
Some people think exams should be replaced by other forms of assessment.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams help students learn the material they study.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams help students learn the material they study.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exams keep students working hard to do well.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams keep students working hard to do well.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams help students learn the material well by giving them a chance to show what they have studied.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams help students learn the material well by giving them a chance to show what they have studied.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exams keep students focused on their studies because they know they must pass the test to move to the next grade.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams keep students focused on their studies because they know they must pass the test to move to the next grade.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams are effective tools for measuring student knowledge because they require students to recall specific facts and study the material deeply, helping them retain important academic knowledge.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams are effective tools for measuring student knowledge because they require students to recall specific facts and study the material deeply, helping them retain important academic knowledge.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, exams encourage students to prepare seriously for their studies, leading them to develop good study habits and time management skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, exams encourage students to prepare seriously for their studies, leading them to develop good study habits and time management skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Exams are useful tools for measuring what students have learned, giving a clear picture of their knowledge at a certain time, which helps teachers identify topics needing more teaching time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams are useful tools for measuring what students have learned, giving a clear picture of their knowledge at a certain time, which helps teachers identify topics needing more teaching time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exams encourage students to study hard and prepare well, teaching them time management and how to work under pressure, thus building important life skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exams encourage students to study hard and prepare well, teaching them time management and how to work under pressure, thus building important life skills.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss whether exams should be replaced by alternative assessment methods in schools and universities.
keyArguments: Exams provide a standardised way to assess knowledge and skills.
Alternative methods like projects and presentations can offer a more holistic evaluation.

plans.label: Version 1: AGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of agree.
plans.point1: Exams offer a standardized measure of student knowledge, ensuring that the grading process is objective and fair across diverse student populations, thereby maintaining academic rigour.
plans.point2: Furthermore, exams motivate students to engage in deep and sustained learning, helping them develop strong time management skills alongside their subject-specific knowledge.

plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of disagree.
plans.point1: The essay argues that traditional exams are essential for maintaining educational standards and assessing accumulated knowledge.
plans.point2: The essay further argues that exams are beneficial because they force students to develop crucial life skills, such as preparation and time management.
